question: Calculate the Retained Income balance at year-end. Opening balance: R379,000. Net profit after tax: R3,403,000. 47,000 shares were repurchased at R8 above the average share price. Interim dividends paid: R394,000. Final dividends declared: R158,000.

question: Fixed assets carrying value at start: R3,672,000. At end: R2,573,000. Depreciation for the year: R466,000. Carrying value of assets sold: R196,000. Calculate the amount paid to purchase fixed assets.
